purpose: Conflict-aware selective union (lever 2): E2 current geometry plus ALS fill-only — overlap ALS is dropped even when consistent (E2 already covers it more precisely; dropping removes the double-surface channel at zero information cost). Dropped-point conflict statistics feed the verification layer.

rule.definition: an ALS point is FILL (kept) iff no E2 point lies within fill_radius_m in XY; otherwise it is OVERLAP (dropped) and counted as CONSISTENT (|dz| <= conflict_tau_m to the nearest-XY E2 point) or CONFLICTED (> conflict_tau_m, stale/misregistration evidence for the verification layer)

rule_v2_note: v1(fill_only) fired its pre-registered falsifier at delta=0: 43% of dropped overlap was vertically-separated (E2 saw only ground at that XY; the ALS point above is genuine roof fill), erasing ~80% of the completeness gain. v2(drop_duplicates_only) drops ONLY duplicate-consistent overlap (XY within fill_radius AND |dz| <= conflict_tau); vertically-separated overlap is kept as FLAGGED fill (verification raw material). v2 predictions: completeness recovers to the E8 level, z-spread stays below E8 (duplicate channel still removed), Roofer recovery persists.

pre_registered_predictions.E9_d000_vs_E8_d000: completeness preserved (fill is the entire benefit), z-spread drops toward the E2 level (~0.186 vs union 0.201), precision >= union, Roofer technical-valid >= union with recovery among the 7 sealed union-regression buildings (42364659/4906967/4906968/4906975/4907514/4907517/4959460)
pre_registered_predictions.E9_delta_vs_E8_delta: z-spread stays flat at the E2 level under delta (overlap contamination channel removed) while E8's rises; fill placement contamination (comp@0.25 decline) remains, similar to E8 — pre-registered limit: selection cannot fix corrupted fill, only flag it
pre_registered_predictions.falsifier: if E9_d000 loses completeness vs E8 (fill radius too aggressive) or Roofer does not recover any regression building, the fill-only rule is miscalibrated
